title: HP High Court District Judiciary Process Server Preparation & Resource Alert
summary: Candidates preparing for upcoming Class-IV District Judiciary recruitments are advised to align their study plan with the 2022 Rules (50 Marks Screening + 40 Marks Written Essay/Letter + 10 Marks Evaluation).
keyTakeaways: Screening test acts as a shortlisting stage (1:5 ratio).
Final merit is determined strictly on the 40 marks written test (Hindi essay + English letter) and 10 marks evaluation.
HP GK carries the single highest individual weightage in the objective screening.

title: HP High Court Process Server 2022 Cycle Complete Final Merit & Archive Analysis
summary: Detailed cutoff and merit analysis from the 2022 District Judiciary examination cycle. The 18 December 2022 screening paper highlighted high competition in general awareness and regional Himachali geography.
keyTakeaways: Screening cutoff varied by district judicial establishment between 36 to 43 marks out of 50 for General category.
Clear, legible handwriting was heavily emphasized in the descriptive written paper.

title: Notification of The HP District Judiciary Staff Rules 2022
summary: The High Court of Himachal Pradesh notified new uniform service and recruitment rules for staff in the District Judiciary, codifying syllabus, educational requirements, and promotion channels.
keyTakeaways: Process Server classified under Class-IV with 10+2 entry qualification.
Screening examination formalized at 50 MCQs for 60 minutes.
